subject: Request: Conditional bridge credit + pilot discount for Theranexus
messages:
From: Anna Lowe <anna@theranexus.io>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procure@theranexus.io
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot ask — request for starter discount + bridge credit

Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — the team at Theranexus is excited about Redwood's latency profile and the private deployment option. We have one ask to get our board comfortable with a pilot: a starter discount for the first 90 days and a small bridge credit to offset early overages while we instrument usage controls.

High level:
- Pilot: 3 months, up to 200k tokens/month initial usage, expected ramp to 400k by month 3
- Ask: 25% off published rate for the first 3 months, and a $10k bridge credit to reconcile overages during onboarding
- Timeline: want contract signed by 9/30 to meet internal timelines

Attached: Theranexus_SOW_v1.pdf with expected consumption profile. Please let me know who at Redwood we should loop in for pricing approval and any standard guardrails.

Best,
Anna Lowe
Director, Product Integrations
Theranexus

--
Attachment: Theranexus_SOW_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 124 KB)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Lowe <anna@theranexus.io>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 09:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot ask — request for starter discount + bridge credit

Anna — thanks, appreciate the clear ask and timeline.

Sharing internally to route for approval. Quick answers for you now: we can move fast on a 90-day pilot but the discount and bridge credit you requested exceed our standard self-serve guardrails. I'll escalate for executive sign-off and come back with a firm yes/no and conditions by EOD Friday (9/15).

Next steps on our end:
- I will open an internal approval thread and include pricing details + recommended mitigation (commitment clause + phased ramp triggers).
- Marissa/Finance: can you run the revenue impact and advise recommended discount cap?
- Legal: we will propose a short-form addendum that includes the bridge credit reconciliation and usage safety-net.

Anna, can you confirm the $10k bridge should be applied as a credit against overage invoices or as a prepaid onboarding credit? That will help legal.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 13 Sep 2028 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Theranexus — request for 25% pilot discount + $10k bridge credit (exec signoff request)

Folks — pulling this into the thread for executive approval. Summary below and ask for VP/CFO signoff. Anna Lowe (Theranexus) wants a 90-day pilot with 25% off list and a $10k bridge credit to cover onboarding overages. Contract target: sign by 2028-09-30.

Why this matters:
- Strategic fit: Theranexus is a 1000-employee digital therapeutics company with potential multi-year deal ($1.2M ARR) if pilot goes well and we convert to Dedicated. They are in healthcare (regulated), so private deployment + SOC-2 readiness is attractive for them.
- Competitive risk: Two competitors are pitching similar latency guarantees; losing momentum risks the entire deal.

Financials (quick view):
- Expected pilot revenue (net): $24k list / $18k at 25% discount over 3 months
- Bridge credit request: $10k (one-time) applied as credit vs overage invoice or invoice offset
- Upside: conversion probability estimated 35% to Dedicated with 12–18 month lead time => expected NPV materially positive under conservative assumptions.

Recommended concession structure (my recommendation):
1) Approve a capped bridge credit of $7,500 instead of $10k, applied as a credit on invoice reconciliation at the end of month 2.
2) Approve a 20% starter discount for the first 60 days (not 90), then revert to list with a short residual onboarding credit if they ramp to the agreed thresholds by month 3.
3) Require a 6-month conversion right-of-first-refusal clause and a minimum 6-month notice before terminating the Dedicated onboarding discussions.

Risk mitigations:
- Add usage safety-net: overage alerts at 50%/75% thresholds and auto-rate limiting if thresholds exceeded without written signoff.
- Legal to draft short-form addendum that limits exposure to the approved bridge cap and ties credits to reconciliation.

Attachments: pricing_grid.xlsx (simple model with sensitivity scenarios).

Ask: Markus/Marissa — can we get VP/CFO signoff on the recommended concession structure by EOD Monday (9/18)? If approved, I will share the outlined concessions back to Theranexus and begin short-form addendum prep with Legal.

Thanks,
Vanessa

--
Attachment: pricing_grid.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 22 KB)
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 18 Sep 2028 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Theranexus — request for 25% pilot discount + $10k bridge credit (exec signoff request)

Vanessa / Marissa / Kim — thanks for the concise memo and the modeling. I reviewed the downside scenarios and the recommended mitigations look reasonable. I will approve a limited exception with the following firm conditions:

Approved concession (CFO sign-off):
- Bridge credit: cap at $7,500, applied as invoice credit at month-2 reconciliation. No prepaid application.
- Discount: 20% starter discount for first 60 days only. After day 60, revert to list rates with a single residual 5% onboarding credit if Theranexus achieves the agreed ramp to 400k tokens/month by end of month 3.
- Contractual triggers: include automatic overage alerts at 50% and 75% of pilot allowance and a hard safety limit at 120% unless an authorized exec approves higher usage in writing.
- Convert/commit language: require a 6-month period where Theranexus commits to engaging with Redwood for Dedicated deployment discussions; include a standard termination notice for pilot.

Please incorporate these items into the short-form addendum and route to Legal and Revenue Ops for DocuSign/email signature. Vanessa: you have my signoff to communicate this to Theranexus and proceed with the short-form PO/AM capture.

Markus Klein
Chief Financial Officer
Redwood Inference
